content:
I had a velcro tie in this area instead of a zip tie.  I think it was from my upgrading the buddy camera and the filtration system during my MK4 to CORE One upgrade.

Makes me appreciate the use of velcro ties for these larger bundles.  No risk of cutting a wire when removing them.
I had 2 zip ties in that area holding down all the cables and then I also tied the Buddy cam USB cable to the whole bundle at some point.  Removed all of the zip ties in this step tho.
